KARST POLJE BASIN SUPERBLOOM — elongated limestone polje basin two kilometres wide enclosed by vertical karst ridges, seasonal floodwater receded to leave mineral-rich silt across which a dense bloom of meadow buttercup and orchid spreads unbroken, ponor swallow-holes pocking the foreground, white limestone cliffs walling the far end

FJORD-MOUTH MEADOW BLOOM — narrow fjord-mouth meadow on a raised post-glacial bench of compacted moraine, bloom-carpet of Norwegian crane's-bill and yarrow spreading to the foreground cliff-edge, dark fjord water dropping thirty metres below, sheer gneiss walls rising eight hundred metres on both flanks into low cloud

NAMIB DESERT BLOOM-FLAT — rare-decade bloom across gravel-plain desert pavement between ancient inselberg granite domes, carpet of Namaqualand daisy and vygies extending to the limit of the flat foreground, weathered dome rising two hundred metres in the mid-ground, distant dune-sea crests glowing orange along the horizon

LAVA-FIELD PIONEER BLOOM — century-old Hawaiian pahoehoe lava-flow field, pioneer ohia lehua shrubs and alien balsam filling every crack and kipuka hollow, black ropy lava texture showing through the mid-ground bloom, steam plume from active vent rising at the horizon, older vegetated lava forming a dark green margin on the left

GLACIAL U-VALLEY SUPERBLOOM — broad glacially scoured U-valley of polished granite pavement and hummocky moraine, valley-floor bloom-carpet of alpine willow-herb and clover spreading wall-to-wall across the flat bottom, lateral moraine terraces rising on both sides into bare scree slopes, hanging valley waterfall visible at the far headwall

BOG SUPERBLOOM — raised peat-bog plateau of Sphagnum hummocks at eight hundred metres, dense bloom-mat of bog asphodel, sundew, and bog-bean spanning the entire foreground surface, black pool-and-hummock pattern breaking up the mid-ground, conifer-forested slopes enclosing the bog on three sides, one open horizon to the west

PATAGONIAN MESETA BLOOM — wind-raked basalt meseta tableland at nine hundred metres above the Patagonian steppe, thin carpet of calafate and purple hardhead spread across the flat foreground caprock, sheer ten-metre black-basalt rim dropping to the steppe plain in the mid-ground, glaciated Andean towers fifty kilometres distant on the horizon

BRAIDED RIVER BLOOM-ISLAND — wide braided glacial-melt river valley with multiple gravel-bar islands, bloom-carpets of Himalayan balsam and river daisy colonising each raised mid-channel island, white braid-channels threading between the foreground bloom-bars, alluvial fan apron spreading from the far valley wall, snow summits above

FOREST-MEADOW CLEARING SUPERBLOOM — broad beaver-meadow clearing in a subalpine spruce-fir forest, dense bloom of blue camas and shooting star carpeting the flat peat-bottom foreground, standing dead timber framing the mid-ground clearing edge, closed-canopy spruce wall forming a dark backdrop, granite ridgeline visible above the treeline

VOLCANIC ISLAND SUMMIT BLOOM — eroded shield-volcano summit caldera rim at nine hundred metres on a sub-Antarctic island, bloom-mat of megaherb Pleurophyllum and Ross lily blanketing the foreground plateau, outer crater wall dropping five hundred metres to the sea on the right, open ocean horizon stretching unbroken to the south
